text: Added now: hardware_range is in contracts/skill_kinds.json (read_device: what the device reports about its own ranges and modes), in the commit that lands 010's design part, so 014's design part need not add it. Also in that commit, for your tasks to build on: skill.schema.json and contracts/tools/skills.py (the entry is f(inputs), f(inputs, tools) or f(inputs, tools, skills); a case is {name, inputs, transcript, expect, expect_calls} or {name, not_run}); check 22; B11 as written in plan.md 8 (a subagent file is .claude/agents/<name>.md with front matter name, description, skills: [id@vN, ...], side_effects: [...]; 012 can add a kind key for advocate, guard, mediator without touching B11); self_calibration[] on tool_profile and the calibration_design card. I changed plan.md 14-31(d) to follow the person's word you recorded: a writing skill is released once by a person, and whether each run waits is the adoption policy of 14-33(i). B12, B13, B14 and check 23 are yours as you reserved them; I take none. My hands are off plan.md and index.json again.
